title: Cartographer
description: A procedural fantasy-atlas studio that grows a whole living world from a seed — and now models the two great engines that move heat and moisture around a planet. THE LIVING PLANET: a from-scratch coupled atmosphere/ocean circulation. The three-cell general circulation (Hadley / Ferrel / Polar) is deflected by a genuine Coriolis rotation whose sign flips across the equator, so the trade winds, mid-latitude westerlies and polar easterlies emerge from first principles, not a painted field — with a sea-level pressure map of subtropical highs and equatorial lows and a land–sea thermal anomaly that pulls an onshore monsoon. From the wind it forms the wind stress and solves the barotropic Stommel vorticity balance ∇²ψ + β ∂ψ/∂x = curl τ for an ocean streamfunction by over-relaxation (ψ=0 on every coast), so the surface current is the curl of ψ — divergence-free and mass-conserving, never crossing a coast — and the β term crowds the return flow onto a western boundary current, a Gulf Stream. A latitudinal sea-surface temperature is then advected along those currents, so warm western-boundary currents carry the tropics poleward and cold currents chill the eastern margins, and the coasts feel it: warm-current shores turn mild and oceanic, cold-current shores turn arid and foggy, re-classified live in the Köppen model. Four new overlays (Winds, Currents, Pressure, Sea temp) recolour the map, and an animated flow layer advects thousands of motes along the live wind or ocean field. All of it is certified in a new PROOF LAB — the house style — that runs the real engine in the browser and checks every invariant with measured numbers: determinism (same seed ⇒ byte-identical terrain, climate, winds, currents, SST and history), a valid mesh, a hydrology that truly drains and conserves rainfall, the circulation physics (ψ=0 on every boundary, current divergence ≪ speed, the Coriolis sign flip, western intensification, a converged Stommel residual), and a well-formed history simulation. On top of the foundations it still ships: plate tectonics, orographic rain, river hydrology and lakes, Whittaker biomes and a real Köppen–Geiger climate; named great rivers; a resource economy of grain, ore, wine and furs with trade-weighted roads; and THE AGES — a deterministic, turn-based history you can scrub and play, where realms seed on the richest ground, grow toward the land's carrying capacity, colonise the frontier, wage border-moving wars, break apart in revolt and fall to plague and famine while the political map breathes across a millennium and an emergent chronicle writes itself. Thematic overlays turn it into an atlas of climate, resources, temperature, rainfall, elevation, pressure, winds, currents and sea temperature — restylable across five palettes (including a luminous Nocturne night-map), inspectable cell by cell (down to the local wind, current and sea temperature), and exportable to PNG or SVG. All client-side, no backend, no assets.
